China Faces Surge in Respiratory Illnesses Amid HMPV Outbreak

Five years post-Covid, China is battling a rise in human metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases, with overcrowded hospitals and crematories reported. The surge primarily affects children and the elderly, with flu-like symptoms. https://t.co/xqqd8Db2Lu
